correctness.rationale: Finite connected Moran birth-death chain absorption yields rational first-/second-moment equations (I-Q)a=1, (I-Q)b=2a-1. Uniform-seed mixture variance formula is correct. Full labeled enumeration 2<=n<=5 covered exactly 0,3,84,3140 edge comparisons; every exact difference product >=0. Two explicit six-vertex connected graph-edge pairs yield strict rational differences of opposite sign in each direction. Replaying the standalone exact-fraction checker establishes each claim, not just sampled examples.

evidence: Hindersin--Traulsen inspect all connected four-vertex graph topologies but analyze conditional mean fixation times; Hathcock--Strogatz derive higher cumulants for conditioned fixation on the regular circle and complete graph rather than single-edge unconditioned variance.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General transition-matrix methods can compute these quantities, but algorithms alone do not imply the two strict sign witnesses or the sharp size obstruction. Neither the conditional mean comparison nor the ring/complete distribution formulas dominate this exact edge-perturbation claim.

evidence: One paper establishes counterintuitive mean **conditional** fixation-time edge effects; one gives expected absorption-time bounds (assuming fitness r>1 for its main theorems); one studies the variance/cumulants of **conditioned** fixation, mainly for complete/ring graphs and large size. The original evolutionary-graph paper defines the model and fixation behavior.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of those statements imply a six-vertex sharp cutoff for the product of changes in **unconditioned** mean and variance under one missing-edge insertion. In particular, no direct monotonic relationship translates conditional time variances to unconditioned absorption variances. The model and routine moment recurrence are expressly not claimed as novel.

evidence: The model is also an invasion/updating process dual to neutral voter-type dynamics, but birth-death versus death-birth conventions, counting null steps, and mixing starting vertices change time laws. Hindersin--Traulsen, arXiv:1406.4415, Section 1.3 provides Markov-matrix notation.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Search terms covered fixation/absorption/consensus-time variance, edge addition, mutant invasion and neutrality. An equivalent assertion would have to compare full unconditioned variance and mean for the same update rule under one-edge insertion, including exclusion through five vertices. No examined text provides this.

value.rationale: First-passage duration uncertainty is distinct from expected waiting time; the results establish a natural sharp size threshold for opposing risk and average effects of a network intervention in a classical evolutionary process. Both qualitative directions are realized by small graphs, explaining why average speed alone can mislead. No general dynamics conclusion beyond the stated finite result is asserted.
